_note: Quiz questions for full-tier entries. difficulty: 1=Easy, 2=Medium, 3=Hard. Answers are drawn directly from the referenced verses — no extra-biblical content. topic_id links back to the person's page for 'learn more' links and sheet dedup; subtopic_id is an optional secondary link for a sub-entity with its own detail page (not used yet on this site).

questions.question: God told Abraham to count the stars as a picture of what?
questions.answer: How many descendants he would have.

questions.question: What did God rename Abram to, as a sign of His covenant promise?
questions.answer: Abraham.

questions.question: To protect himself in Egypt, what did Abraham tell Pharaoh that Sarah was?
questions.answer: His sister (a half-truth — she was also his wife).

questions.question: What weapon did young David use to defeat Goliath?
questions.answer: A sling and a stone.

questions.question: What instrument was David skilled at playing?
questions.answer: The harp (lyre).

questions.question: 1 Chronicles 21:1 names who as inciting David to take a census of Israel?
questions.answer: Satan.

questions.question: Whose mother-in-law was Naomi?
questions.answer: Ruth's.

questions.question: Whose field was Ruth gleaning in when Boaz first noticed her?
questions.answer: Boaz's own field, near Bethlehem.

questions.question: What did Ruth do at the threshing floor at Naomi's instruction?
questions.answer: She lay down at Boaz's feet and asked him to spread his covering over her, invoking his role as a kinsman-redeemer.

questions.question: What was Peter's occupation before he followed Jesus?
questions.answer: A fisherman.

questions.question: What was Peter's name before Jesus renamed him?
questions.answer: Simon.

questions.question: What did Paul publicly oppose Peter for doing in Antioch?
questions.answer: Withdrawing from eating with Gentile believers under pressure from certain men from James.

questions.question: On the road to which city did Paul encounter the risen Christ?
questions.answer: Damascus.

questions.question: What was Paul called before his encounter with Christ on the road to Damascus?
questions.answer: Saul (of Tarsus).

questions.question: What physical affliction did Paul call his 'thorn in the flesh'?
questions.answer: Scripture doesn't say — Paul never identifies what it was, only that it kept him dependent on God's grace.

questions.question: What did God use to get Moses' attention in the wilderness of Midian?
questions.answer: A bush that burned but was not consumed.

questions.question: What ordinary object did God turn into a snake as a sign for Moses to show Pharaoh?
questions.answer: His staff.

questions.question: What did Moses do at Meribah that kept him from entering the promised land?
questions.answer: In anger, he struck the rock instead of speaking to it as God commanded, and took credit alongside God for producing the water.

questions.question: What role did God give Aaron because Moses said he was slow of speech?
questions.answer: Aaron became Moses' spokesman before Pharaoh and Israel.

questions.question: What did Aaron make for the people while Moses was on Mount Sinai?
questions.answer: A golden calf, cast from the people's gold earrings.

questions.question: How did God settle the dispute over Aaron's right to the priesthood in Numbers 16-17?
questions.answer: Aaron's staff, alone among twelve gathered from each tribe, sprouted, budded, blossomed, and bore almonds overnight.

questions.question: How old was Sarah when she laughed at God's promise that she would have a son?
questions.answer: Ninety years old.

questions.question: What relation was Sarah to Abraham besides being his wife?
questions.answer: His half-sister — they shared the same father, Terah, but different mothers.

questions.question: What New Testament letter holds Sarah up as a model of a wife's hope set on God?
questions.answer: 1 Peter (1 Peter 3:5-6).

questions.question: What did Isaac carry up the mountain for his own sacrifice?
questions.answer: The wood for the burnt offering.

questions.question: How was Isaac's wife Rebekah found?
questions.answer: Abraham sent his servant back to his own kindred in Mesopotamia, and the servant's prayer for a sign was answered by Rebekah at a well.

questions.question: What sin did Isaac repeat from his father Abraham's life?
questions.answer: He told a foreign king (Abimelech) that his wife was his sister, out of fear for his own life.

questions.question: What name did Hagar give to God after He met her in the wilderness?
questions.answer: El Roi, 'the God who sees me.'

questions.question: Who was Hagar before she became Abraham's wife?
questions.answer: Sarah's Egyptian servant.

questions.question: What did God open Hagar's eyes to see when Ishmael was about to die of thirst?
questions.answer: A well of water.

questions.question: What skill did Ishmael grow up practicing in the wilderness of Paran?
questions.answer: He became an archer.

questions.question: Even though Ishmael wasn't the covenant son, what did God still promise about his future?
questions.answer: That he would father twelve princes and become a great nation.

questions.question: What did Ishmael and Isaac do together at the end of Genesis 25?
questions.answer: They buried their father Abraham at the cave of Machpelah.

questions.question: What did Jochebed make to protect baby Moses?
questions.answer: A papyrus basket coated with tar and pitch.

questions.question: Who did Pharaoh's daughter unknowingly hire to nurse the baby she found in the basket?
questions.answer: Jochebed — the baby's own mother.

questions.question: What does Hebrews 11 commend about Moses' parents' decision to hide him?
questions.answer: That they were not afraid of the king's edict — an act of faith.

questions.question: Where was Zipporah from?
questions.answer: Midian — she was the daughter of Jethro, a Midianite priest.

questions.question: What did Zipporah do to save Moses' life on the road back to Egypt?
questions.answer: She circumcised their son and touched Moses with the foreskin, declaring him 'a bridegroom of blood.'

questions.question: Who brought Zipporah and her sons to Moses after the Exodus?
questions.answer: Her father, Jethro.

questions.question: What did Naomi ask people to call her instead of her own name when she returned to Bethlehem?
questions.answer: Mara, meaning 'bitter.'

questions.question: Why did Naomi and her family first go to Moab?
questions.answer: A famine in Bethlehem.

questions.question: What plan did Naomi devise to secure Ruth's future?
questions.answer: She sent Ruth to the threshing floor to ask Boaz, as a kinsman-redeemer, to spread his covering over her.

questions.question: What did Boaz tell his workers to do for Ruth while she gleaned?
questions.answer: Let extra grain fall on purpose for her to gather.

questions.question: What did the nearer kinsman do at the city gate when Boaz offered him the right to redeem Elimelech's land?
questions.answer: He declined, removing his sandal to confirm the transfer to Boaz.

questions.question: Who does Matthew's genealogy name as Boaz's mother?
questions.answer: Rahab.

questions.question: What did God call the young boy Samuel to do in the night at Shiloh?
questions.answer: Listen for God's voice and answer, 'Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.'

questions.question: What did Samuel tell Saul was 'better than sacrifice'?
questions.answer: To obey.

questions.question: Why did Samuel almost anoint Jesse's eldest son Eliab as king instead of David?
questions.answer: He judged by Eliab's outward appearance, until God told him He looks at the heart instead.

questions.question: What did Jonathan give David as a sign of their covenant friendship?
questions.answer: His own robe, armor, sword, bow, and belt.

questions.question: How did Jonathan warn David that Saul meant to kill him?
questions.answer: With a prearranged signal using arrows.

questions.question: Who did David show kindness to for Jonathan's sake after Jonathan's death?
questions.answer: Jonathan's crippled son, Mephibosheth.

questions.question: What did David do while Bathsheba's husband Uriah was away at war?
questions.answer: He saw her bathing, sent for her, and she conceived a child.

questions.question: What name did the prophet Nathan give to Bathsheba's second son with David?
questions.answer: Jedidiah, meaning 'beloved of the LORD' (the boy is known to history as Solomon).

questions.question: How does Matthew's genealogy of Jesus refer to Bathsheba?
questions.answer: Not by her own name, but as 'the wife of Uriah.'

questions.question: What did Solomon ask God for at Gibeon, instead of riches or long life?
questions.answer: An understanding heart to discern between good and evil.

questions.question: What foreign ruler visited Solomon to test him with hard questions?
questions.answer: The Queen of Sheba.

questions.question: What turned Solomon's heart to foreign gods in his old age?
questions.answer: His seven hundred wives and three hundred concubines, many of them foreign women the Law had warned against marrying.

questions.question: Whose son was Jesse, and whose father?
questions.answer: The grandson of Boaz and Ruth, and the father of David.

questions.question: Which of Jesse's sons did Samuel not initially even call in from the fields?
questions.answer: David, the youngest.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 11:1 call the coming Messiah in relation to Jesse?
questions.answer: 'A shoot... from the stem of Jesse' (the root of Jesse).

questions.question: Who anointed Saul as Israel's first king?
questions.answer: The prophet Samuel.

questions.question: What did Saul do at Gilgal that was his first recorded act of disobedience?
questions.answer: He offered a sacrifice himself instead of waiting for Samuel.

questions.question: Whom did Saul consult at En-dor before his final battle?
questions.answer: A medium, to summon the spirit of Samuel.

questions.question: Whose son was King Rehoboam?
questions.answer: Solomon's.

questions.question: What harsh answer did Rehoboam give the people who asked for lighter labor?
questions.answer: That he would make their yoke heavier, disciplining them with "scorpions."

questions.question: Which Egyptian king invaded Judah in Rehoboam's fifth year and plundered the temple?
questions.answer: Shishak.

questions.question: Over how many of Israel's tribes did Jeroboam become king?
questions.answer: Ten (the northern tribes).

questions.question: What two objects did Jeroboam set up at Bethel and Dan for the people to worship?
questions.answer: Two golden calves.

questions.question: What miraculous sign confirmed the man of God's warning to Jeroboam at Bethel's altar?
questions.answer: The altar split apart, and Jeroboam's hand withered (then was restored).

questions.question: Who was Ahab's wife, who introduced Baal worship to Israel?
questions.answer: Jezebel.

questions.question: Whose vineyard did Ahab covet and unjustly seize?
questions.answer: Naboth's.

questions.question: How did Ahab die, as the prophet Micaiah had foretold?
questions.answer: Struck by a stray arrow at Ramoth-gilead.

questions.question: Whose son was King Jehoshaphat of Judah?
questions.answer: Asa's.

questions.question: What did Jehoshaphat do when a vast enemy coalition invaded Judah?
questions.answer: He proclaimed a fast and prayed publicly for God's help.

questions.question: Which prophet rebuked Jehoshaphat for allying with wicked King Ahab?
questions.answer: Jehu son of Hanani.

questions.question: Who anointed Jehu king over Israel?
questions.answer: A young prophet sent by Elisha.

questions.question: How did Jezebel die, fulfilling Elijah's earlier prophecy?
questions.answer: She was thrown from a window and eaten by dogs.

questions.question: What did Jehu fail to remove even after purging Baal worship from Israel?
questions.answer: The golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

questions.question: What object did Hezekiah destroy because Israel had begun worshiping it as an idol?
questions.answer: The bronze serpent Moses had made (Nehushtan).

questions.question: How many Assyrian soldiers did the angel of the LORD strike down in one night?
What sign did God give Hezekiah to confirm his life would be extended fifteen years?
questions.answer: The sun's shadow moved backward.

questions.question: Whose son was King Manasseh of Judah?
questions.answer: Hezekiah's.

questions.question: What happened to Manasseh that led him to humble himself before God?
questions.answer: He was captured by the Assyrians and taken to Babylon in bronze shackles.

questions.question: In which biblical book alone is Manasseh's repentance and restoration recorded?
questions.answer: 2 Chronicles (not 2 Kings).

questions.question: How old was Josiah when he became king?
questions.answer: Eight.

questions.question: What did Hilkiah discover during the temple repairs Josiah ordered?
questions.answer: The Book of the Law.

questions.question: How did Josiah die?
questions.answer: Fatally wounded in battle against Pharaoh Necho at Megiddo.

questions.question: What was Zedekiah's original name before Nebuchadnezzar renamed him?
questions.answer: Mattaniah.

questions.question: Which prophet did Zedekiah repeatedly consult but fail to heed?
questions.answer: Jeremiah.

questions.question: What was the last thing Zedekiah saw before he was blinded?
questions.answer: The execution of his own sons at Riblah.

questions.question: On what mountain did Elijah defeat the prophets of Baal?
questions.answer: Mount Carmel.

questions.question: How did God speak to Elijah at Horeb after his flight from Jezebel?
questions.answer: In a still small voice (a gentle whisper).

questions.question: How did Elijah leave the earth?
questions.answer: Taken up to heaven in a whirlwind by a chariot of fire.

questions.question: What did Elisha ask for from Elijah before Elijah was taken up to heaven?
questions.answer: A double portion of his spirit.

questions.question: How many times did Naaman have to wash in the Jordan to be healed of leprosy?
questions.answer: Seven.

questions.question: What happened to Gehazi after he secretly took payment from Naaman?
questions.answer: He was struck with Naaman's leprosy.

questions.question: What did a seraph touch to Isaiah's lips in his vision of God's throne?
questions.answer: A burning coal.

questions.question: What sign did Isaiah give King Ahaz, involving a child named Immanuel?
questions.answer: A virgin/young woman would conceive and bear a son called Immanuel.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 53 describe that the New Testament applies to Jesus?
questions.answer: A suffering servant pierced for others' transgressions.

questions.question: What excuse did Jeremiah give God when first called to be a prophet?
questions.answer: That he was only a youth.

questions.question: What did King Jehoiakim do to the scroll of Jeremiah's prophecies?
questions.answer: He cut it up and burned it.

questions.question: What new kind of covenant did Jeremiah promise God would make with His people?
questions.answer: A covenant written on their hearts, not on stone.

questions.question: Where was Ezekiel when he received his prophetic call?
questions.answer: Beside the Chebar River, among the Babylonian exiles.

questions.question: What vision showed God restoring Israel's spirit through renewed life?
questions.answer: The valley of dry bones.

questions.question: What was Ezekiel forbidden to do when his wife died suddenly?
questions.answer: Mourn her openly, as a sign to the exiles.

questions.question: What did Daniel and his three friends refuse to eat in Babylon?
questions.answer: The king's food (royal delicacies).

questions.question: What happened to Daniel's three friends when they refused to worship Nebuchadnezzar's golden image?
questions.answer: They were thrown into a fiery furnace and emerged unharmed.

questions.question: Why was Daniel thrown into the lions' den?
questions.answer: For continuing to pray to God despite a royal decree forbidding it.

questions.question: Whom did God command Hosea to marry as a picture of Israel's unfaithfulness?
questions.answer: Gomer.

questions.question: What did Hosea do after Gomer left him?
questions.answer: Bought her back and took her home again.

questions.question: What verse from Hosea did Jesus quote against religious hardness of heart?
questions.answer: "I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice."

questions.question: What disaster does the book of Joel describe as a picture of the coming day of the LORD?
questions.answer: A devastating locust plague.

questions.question: What did Joel promise God would one day pour out "on all flesh"?
questions.answer: His Spirit.

questions.question: Who quoted Joel's prophecy of the Spirit at Pentecost?
questions.answer: The apostle Peter.

questions.question: What was Amos's occupation before God called him to prophesy?
questions.answer: A shepherd (and sycamore-fig farmer).

questions.question: What famous phrase did Amos use to describe what God wants instead of empty ritual?
questions.answer: "Let justice roll down like waters."

questions.question: Which priest confronted Amos and told him to stop prophesying at Bethel?
questions.answer: Amaziah.

questions.question: How many verses long is the book of Obadiah?
questions.answer: 21 — the shortest book in the Old Testament.

questions.question: Against which nation is Obadiah's prophecy directed?
questions.answer: Edom.

questions.question: What had Edom done that Obadiah condemns?
questions.answer: Gloated over and helped plunder Jerusalem when it fell.

questions.question: Where was Jonah sent to preach, a mission he tried to flee instead?
questions.answer: Nineveh.

questions.question: How long was Jonah inside the great fish?
questions.answer: Three days and three nights.

questions.question: Why was Jonah angry after Nineveh repented?
questions.answer: Because God showed mercy and did not destroy the city.

questions.question: What town did Micah prophesy would be the Messiah's birthplace?
questions.answer: Bethlehem.

questions.question: What three things does Micah 6:8 say the LORD requires?
questions.answer: To do justice, love kindness, and walk humbly with God.

questions.question: Whose warning was cited in Jeremiah's own defense as an example of a heeded prophet?
questions.answer: Micah's.

questions.question: What city does the book of Nahum announce judgment against?
questions.answer: Nineveh.

questions.question: What earlier city's fall does Nahum cite as proof no city is beyond God's judgment?
questions.answer: Thebes (No-amon).

questions.question: What does Nahum say about God's character even while pronouncing judgment?
questions.answer: That the LORD is slow to anger.

questions.question: What does Habakkuk complain to God about at the start of his book?
questions.answer: Injustice and violence in Judah that seem to go unanswered.

questions.question: Which nation did God say He was raising up to bring judgment on Judah?
questions.answer: The Babylonians (Chaldeans).

questions.question: What famous phrase from Habakkuk 2:4 is quoted three times in the New Testament?
questions.answer: "The righteous shall live by his faith."

questions.question: During which king's reign did Zephaniah prophesy?
questions.answer: Josiah.

questions.question: What earlier king is Zephaniah's genealogy traced back to?
questions.answer: Hezekiah.

questions.question: What beautiful image closes the book of Zephaniah?
questions.answer: God rejoicing over His people with singing.

questions.question: What had the returned exiles built for themselves while leaving the temple unfinished?
questions.answer: Paneled houses.

questions.question: In which Persian king's reign did Haggai prophesy?
questions.answer: Darius (I).

questions.question: What did Haggai promise about the rebuilt temple's future glory?
questions.answer: That it would be greater than the former (Solomon's) temple.

questions.question: Whose grandson was the prophet Zechariah?
questions.answer: Iddo's.

questions.question: What animal did Zechariah prophesy the coming king would ride?
questions.answer: A donkey.

questions.question: How much silver did Zechariah prophesy would be paid, later linked to Judas's betrayal?
questions.answer: Thirty pieces of silver.

questions.question: What does the name "Malachi" mean?
questions.answer: "My messenger."

questions.question: What had priests been offering God instead of their best animals?
questions.answer: Blind, lame, and diseased ones.

questions.question: Who did Malachi promise would come before "the great and awesome day of the LORD"?
questions.answer: Elijah.

questions.question: What promise did Nathan deliver to David about his throne?
questions.answer: That it would be established forever.

questions.question: What story did Nathan tell David to confront him over Bathsheba and Uriah?
questions.answer: The parable of a rich man stealing a poor man's only ewe lamb.

questions.question: Whose side did Nathan take when Adonijah tried to seize the throne?
questions.answer: Solomon's.

questions.question: What did Gad tell David to do early in his years as a fugitive?
questions.answer: Leave the stronghold and go to Judah.

questions.question: What three punishments did Gad offer David after his sinful census?
questions.answer: Famine, military defeat, or plague.

questions.question: Where did Gad instruct David to build an altar, later the site of Solomon's temple?
questions.answer: The threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

questions.question: What did Eli mistake Hannah's silent prayer for?
questions.answer: Drunkenness.

questions.question: What sin did Eli's sons Hophni and Phinehas commit as priests?
questions.answer: Taking the best portions of offerings by force and committing immorality.

questions.question: What news caused Eli to fall backward and die?
questions.answer: That the ark of the covenant had been captured.

questions.question: Why did Eleazar become next in line for the priesthood instead of his older brothers?
questions.answer: Nadab and Abihu were struck dead for offering unauthorized fire.

questions.question: On what mountain was the high priesthood transferred from Aaron to Eleazar?
questions.answer: Mount Hor.

questions.question: Who did Eleazar work with to divide the promised land among the tribes?
questions.answer: Joshua.

questions.question: What did Phinehas do at Baal-peor to stop a plague?
questions.answer: He killed an Israelite man and a Midianite woman with a spear.

questions.question: What covenant did God grant Phinehas because of his zeal?
questions.answer: A covenant of peace and a perpetual priesthood.

questions.question: What did Phinehas do when the Transjordan tribes built a controversial altar?
questions.answer: He went to talk with them before assuming rebellion, helping avoid civil war.

questions.question: What role did David ask Zadok to play during Absalom's rebellion?
questions.answer: Keep the ark in Jerusalem and relay intelligence back to David.

questions.question: Who did Zadok anoint as king at the Gihon spring?
questions.answer: Solomon.

questions.question: What happened to Abiathar's priesthood as a result of Zadok's loyalty?
questions.answer: Solomon removed Abiathar and made Zadok sole high priest.

questions.question: How did Abiathar survive when Saul massacred the priests of Nob?
questions.answer: He escaped and fled to David.

questions.question: Whose side did Abiathar take when Adonijah tried to seize David's throne?
questions.answer: Adonijah's.

questions.question: What did Solomon do to Abiathar as a result?
questions.answer: Removed him from the priesthood and banished him.

questions.question: What did Hilkiah discover during temple repairs under Josiah?
questions.answer: The Book of the Law.

questions.question: Which prophetess did Hilkiah consult after the discovery?
questions.answer: Huldah.

questions.question: What was Josiah's reaction when the Law was read to him?
questions.answer: He tore his clothes in grief.

questions.question: Whom did Jehoiada and his wife Jehosheba hide in the temple for six years?
questions.answer: The infant prince Joash.

questions.question: What happened to Queen Athaliah when Jehoiada crowned Joash king?
questions.answer: She was executed.

questions.question: What tragic event happened to Jehoiada's own son after Jehoiada died?
questions.answer: He was stoned to death by order of King Joash.

questions.question: What was Ezra's profession, described as "skilled in the Law of Moses"?
questions.answer: Priest and scribe.

questions.question: Why did Ezra refuse to ask the king for a military escort?
questions.answer: He was ashamed to, having told the king God's hand protects those who seek Him.

questions.question: What did Ezra do before a great assembly at the Water Gate?
questions.answer: Read the Law aloud from morning until midday.

questions.question: What sign did Rahab hang from her window so the Israelites would spare her family?
questions.answer: A scarlet (red) cord.

questions.question: In whose genealogy is Rahab named in the New Testament?
questions.answer: Jesus Christ's (Matthew's genealogy).

questions.question: How old was Caleb when he asked to take the hill country of Hebron from the Anakim?
questions.answer: Eighty-five years old.

questions.question: How did Othniel win Achsah, Caleb's daughter, as his wife?
questions.answer: By capturing the city of Kiriath-sepher.

questions.question: What distinctive physical trait of Ehud's did Scripture note, which helped him surprise King Eglon's guards?
questions.answer: He was left-handed.

questions.question: What unusual weapon did Shamgar use to kill six hundred Philistines?
questions.answer: An ox goad.

questions.question: What did Jael use to kill Sisera while he slept in her tent?
questions.answer: A tent peg and a hammer.

questions.question: What items did Achan take from Jericho's devoted plunder?
questions.answer: A beautiful robe from Shinar, silver, and a bar of gold.

questions.question: What vow did Jephthah make before going into battle against Ammon?
questions.answer: That whatever came out of his house to meet him on his return would belong to the LORD, offered as a burnt offering.

questions.question: How many years did Tola judge Israel?
questions.answer: Twenty-three years.

questions.question: How many sons did Jair have, and what did each one ride?
questions.answer: Thirty sons, each riding his own donkey.

questions.question: How many sons and how many daughters did Ibzan have?
questions.answer: Thirty sons and thirty daughters.

questions.question: From which tribe did the judge Elon come?
questions.answer: Zebulun.

questions.question: How many sons and grandsons did Abdon have, and what did they all ride?
questions.answer: Forty sons and thirty grandsons, all riding on seventy donkeys.

questions.question: What did Ziba bring David when he met him fleeing Jerusalem during Absalom's revolt?
questions.answer: Donkeys, bread, raisins, summer fruit, and wine.

questions.question: Who wanted to kill Shimei for cursing David, and how did David respond?
questions.answer: Abishai wanted to kill him, but David restrained him, saying to let him curse since the LORD had told him to.

questions.question: What did Ahithophel do after Absalom rejected his military advice in favor of Hushai's?
questions.answer: He went home, set his affairs in order, and hanged himself.

questions.question: What task did David give Hushai when he sent him back to Jerusalem during Absalom's revolt?
questions.answer: To pretend loyalty to Absalom and work to defeat Ahithophel's counsel from within.

questions.question: What sacred object was captured by the Philistines the same day Hophni and Phinehas died?
questions.answer: The ark of the covenant.

questions.question: How many priests did Doeg kill at Saul's command after Ahimelech helped David?
questions.answer: Eighty-five priests who wore the linen ephod.

questions.question: Who murdered Abner, and why?
questions.answer: Joab, in revenge for Abner's killing of Joab's brother Asahel in battle.

questions.question: Who assassinated Ish-bosheth, and how did David respond to them?
questions.answer: His own captains Baanah and Rechab; David had them executed for murdering an innocent man.

questions.question: What did Baanah and Rechab bring to David expecting a reward, after murdering Ish-bosheth?
questions.answer: Ish-bosheth's severed head.

questions.question: What does the name "Nabal" mean, and how does Scripture connect it to his character?
questions.answer: It means "fool" -- Scripture says "as his name is, so is he... folly is with him."

questions.question: What did Abigail do when she learned David was coming to take vengeance on Nabal's household?
questions.answer: She quickly gathered provisions and rode out to meet David, interceding before he reached them.

questions.question: How did Michal help David escape when Saul sent men to kill him?
questions.answer: She lowered him through a window and put a household idol in his bed to deceive the pursuers.

questions.question: Why did Uriah refuse to go home to his wife while home from battle at David's invitation?
questions.answer: Because his fellow soldiers and the ark were still camped in the field, and he would not enjoy comforts they could not.

questions.question: How did Joab kill Amasa?
questions.answer: He pretended to greet him warmly, took his beard as if to kiss him, and struck him fatally with a concealed sword.

questions.question: What did David charge Solomon to do about Joab on his deathbed, and why?
questions.answer: Not to let Joab die peacefully in old age, because of the innocent blood he had shed (Abner's and Amasa's) in peacetime.

questions.question: What happened to Absalom that left him trapped and vulnerable during the final battle?
questions.answer: His hair (or head) caught fast in the branches of a great oak tree.

questions.question: What request did Adonijah make to Solomon through Bathsheba that led to his execution?
questions.answer: That he be given Abishag, David's attendant, as a wife.

questions.question: How did the city of Abel Beth-maacah avoid destruction from Joab's siege over Sheba's rebellion?
questions.answer: A wise woman from the city persuaded the people to behead Sheba and throw his head over the wall.

questions.question: Who assassinated King Elah of Israel, and in what state was Elah at the time?
questions.answer: Zimri, his chariot commander, killed him while he was drunk.

questions.question: How long did Zimri reign as king of Israel before his death?
questions.answer: Seven days.

questions.question: What city did Omri found as Israel's new capital?
questions.answer: Samaria.

questions.question: What did Jezebel arrange to happen to Naboth so Ahab could take his vineyard?
questions.answer: She arranged false witnesses to accuse him of blasphemy, leading to his death by stoning.

questions.question: How many of the LORD's prophets did Obadiah hide from Jezebel, and how?
questions.answer: A hundred, hidden fifty at a time in two caves and fed with bread and water.

questions.question: Why did Naboth refuse to sell his vineyard to King Ahab?
questions.answer: Because it was his ancestral inheritance, which God's law protected from being given away.

questions.question: What judgment fell on Gehazi after he lied to obtain silver and clothing from Naaman?
questions.answer: Naaman's leprosy clung to Gehazi and his descendants.

questions.question: What did Elisha instruct Naaman to do to be healed of leprosy?
questions.answer: Wash seven times in the Jordan River.

questions.question: How did the infant Joash survive Athaliah's massacre of the royal family?
questions.answer: His aunt Jehosheba secretly rescued and hid him for six years.

questions.question: How old was Jehoiada when he died, and what honor did he receive?
questions.answer: 130 years old; he was buried among the kings of Judah for the good he had done.

questions.question: Who did Josiah's officials consult to confirm the authenticity of the rediscovered Book of the Law?
questions.answer: Huldah the prophetess.

questions.question: What did King Jehoiakim do when Baruch's scroll of Jeremiah's warnings was read to him?
questions.answer: He cut it apart with a knife and burned it in a brazier.

questions.question: What did Ebed-Melech use to cushion the ropes when pulling Jeremiah out of the cistern?
questions.answer: Old rags and worn-out clothes.

questions.question: Who assassinated Gedaliah, and what happened to the remaining Judeans as a result?
questions.answer: Ishmael, a man of royal blood; the terrified remnant then fled to Egypt.

questions.question: What did Shadrach and his friends say to Nebuchadnezzar about God's deliverance before being thrown in the furnace?
questions.answer: That God was able to deliver them, but even if He did not, they still would not worship the king's idol.

questions.question: What disrespectful act did Belshazzar commit at his feast that provoked God's judgment?
questions.answer: He drank from the sacred gold and silver vessels taken from the Jerusalem temple while praising idols.

questions.question: What compromise did Daniel propose to Ashpenaz so he could avoid the king's food without endangering him?
questions.answer: A ten-day test eating only vegetables and water, compared to the young men eating the king's food.

questions.question: What did Mordecai discover and report that saved King Ahasuerus's life?
questions.answer: A plot by two royal officers to assassinate the king.

questions.question: What ultimately happened to Haman on the gallows he had built for Mordecai?
questions.answer: He was hanged on it himself.

questions.question: What promise did God give Zerubbabel through the prophet Zechariah about how the temple would be completed?
questions.answer: "Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit."

questions.question: What excuse did Nehemiah repeatedly give for refusing Sanballat's invitations to meet at Ono?
questions.answer: "I am doing a great work and I cannot come down."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah discover Tobiah had been given inside the temple, and how did he respond?
questions.answer: A room formerly used for offerings; Nehemiah threw out his belongings and had it cleansed.

questions.question: What did God say about Eliphaz and Job's other two friends at the end of the book?
questions.answer: That they had not spoken correctly about Him, the way His servant Job had.

questions.question: What did Orpah do when Naomi urged her daughters-in-law to return to their own people?
questions.answer: She kissed Naomi goodbye and returned to Moab, while Ruth stayed with Naomi.

questions.question: What did Zaccheus pledge to do after Jesus came to his house?
questions.answer: Give half his possessions to the poor and repay fourfold anyone he had defrauded.

questions.question: How did Paul ask Philemon to receive his runaway slave Onesimus?
questions.answer: No longer as a slave, but as a beloved brother.

questions.question: What title did Bartimaeus use to call out to Jesus?
questions.answer: "Son of David."

questions.question: Why was Simon of Cyrene forced to carry Jesus's cross?
questions.answer: Roman soldiers compelled him, since Jesus, already badly beaten, could not carry it any further.

questions.question: What core teaching did Jesus give Nicodemus about entering the kingdom of God?
questions.answer: That one must be "born again" (born of water and the Spirit).

questions.question: What did Joseph of Arimathea ask Pilate for after Jesus's death?
questions.answer: Permission to take Jesus's body for burial.

questions.question: How many days had Lazarus been in the tomb by the time Jesus arrived?
questions.answer: Four days.

questions.question: What confession of faith did Martha make to Jesus at Lazarus's tomb?
questions.answer: "I do believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God."

questions.question: What did Jesus say Mary's costly anointing of His feet was preparing Him for?
questions.answer: His burial.

questions.question: Who was the first person to see the risen Jesus and announce His resurrection to the other disciples?
questions.answer: Mary Magdalene.

questions.question: At what moment did Cleopas and his companion finally recognize the risen Jesus?
questions.answer: When He broke the bread at their meal in Emmaus.

questions.question: What crimes was Barabbas imprisoned for before his release at Jesus's trial?
questions.answer: Insurrection and murder.

questions.question: What did Jesus do for Malchus after Peter cut off his ear?
questions.answer: He touched his ear and healed him.

questions.question: What exactly was Ananias and Sapphira's sin, according to Peter?
questions.answer: Lying to the Holy Spirit by claiming to give the full proceeds of their sale while secretly keeping some back.

questions.question: What did Ananias call Saul when he came to restore his sight, despite Saul's reputation as a persecutor?
questions.answer: "Brother Saul."

questions.question: What did Stephen pray for the people who were stoning him, just before he died?
questions.answer: That God would not hold the sin against them (he forgave them).

questions.question: What Old Testament book was the Ethiopian official reading when Philip met him on the Gaza road?
questions.answer: Isaiah.

questions.question: What did Simon the sorcerer try to buy from Peter and John, and why was this wrong?
questions.answer: The power to give the Holy Spirit by the laying on of hands; he treated God's gift as something to purchase for his own gain.

questions.question: What happened while Peter was still preaching to Cornelius's household?
questions.answer: The Holy Spirit fell on all who were listening.

questions.question: What does the name "Barnabas" mean, and why was it given to him?
questions.answer: "Son of Encouragement" -- given by the apostles because of his generous, encouraging character.

questions.question: Why did Paul refuse to take John Mark on the second missionary journey?
questions.answer: Because Mark had deserted them partway through the first journey, at Pamphylia.

questions.question: What did Paul and Silas do at midnight in the Philippian prison, right before the earthquake?
questions.answer: They were praying and singing hymns of praise to God.

questions.question: What did Paul encourage Timothy not to let others do because of his youth?
questions.answer: Look down on him; instead he should be an example in speech, conduct, love, faith, and purity.

questions.question: What task did Paul leave Titus to do on the island of Crete?
questions.answer: Organize the churches and appoint elders in every city.

questions.question: What trade did Lydia work in?
questions.answer: She was a dealer in purple cloth.

questions.question: What did Priscilla and Aquila do for the preacher Apollos when they realized his understanding was incomplete?
questions.answer: They took him aside privately and explained the way of God to him more accurately.

questions.question: What did Paul say about the relationship between his own ministry and Apollos's in Corinth?
questions.answer: "I planted, Apollos watered, but God was causing the growth" -- they were united in service, not rivals.

questions.question: Why did Paul say Demas deserted him, according to 2 Timothy?
questions.answer: Because he had loved this present world.

questions.question: What happened to Eutychus during Paul's long late-night sermon in Troas?
questions.answer: He fell asleep, fell from a third-story window, and was picked up dead -- then Paul raised him back to life.

questions.question: What was Felix's reaction when Paul spoke to him about righteousness, self-control, and the coming judgment?
questions.answer: He became frightened and sent Paul away, saying he would call for him later.

questions.question: What did Festus exclaim to Paul while he was explaining the resurrection of Christ?
questions.answer: "You are out of your mind! Your great learning is driving you mad."

questions.question: What did King Agrippa say to Paul after hearing his testimony?
questions.answer: "In a short time you will persuade me to become a Christian."

questions.question: What warning did Gamaliel give the Sanhedrin about opposing the apostles?
questions.answer: That if their movement was of God, the council would risk being found fighting against God Himself.

questions.question: What did the grieving widows show Peter when he arrived after Tabitha's death?
questions.answer: The tunics and garments Tabitha had made for them.

questions.question: Why did Epaphroditus nearly die during his mission to Paul?
questions.answer: He risked his life doing the work of Christ, serving Paul on the Philippian church's behalf.

questions.question: What civic position did Erastus hold in Corinth?
questions.answer: City treasurer.

questions.question: What did Diotrephes do to church members who welcomed John's messengers?
questions.answer: He put them out of the church.

questions.question: What happened to Elymas (Bar-Jesus) after he opposed Paul and Barnabas before Sergius Paulus?
questions.answer: Paul declared judgment on him, and he was struck blind for a time.

questions.question: What unusual phrase does Genesis use to describe Enoch's life that it uses of almost no one else?
questions.answer: That he 'walked with God.'

questions.question: What happened to Enoch instead of dying?
questions.answer: God took him.

questions.question: According to Hebrews, why was Enoch taken up by God?
questions.answer: Because he pleased God through his faith.

questions.question: How many years did Methuselah live, the longest of anyone recorded in Scripture?
questions.answer: 969 years.

questions.question: Who was Methuselah's father?
questions.answer: Enoch.

questions.question: Who was Methuselah's grandson, born through his son Lamech?
questions.answer: Noah.

questions.question: How many wives did Lamech take, making him the first man in Scripture recorded doing so?
questions.answer: Two -- Adah and Zillah.

questions.question: In Lamech's boastful poem, how many times would he be avenged compared to Cain's sevenfold protection?
questions.answer: Seventy-sevenfold.

questions.question: Which of Lamech's sons is remembered as an ancestor of those who forge tools of bronze and iron?
questions.answer: Tubal-cain.

questions.question: What is Nimrod famously called in Genesis 10?
questions.answer: A mighty hunter before the LORD.

questions.question: In what land did the beginning of Nimrod's kingdom lie?
questions.answer: Shinar.

questions.question: Whose grandson was Nimrod?
questions.answer: Ham's (through Cush).

questions.question: What two roles did Melchizedek hold at once?
questions.answer: King of Salem and priest of God Most High.

questions.question: What did Melchizedek bring out to Abram after his victory over the eastern kings?
questions.answer: Bread and wine.

questions.question: According to Psalm 110, whose priesthood would be 'according to the order of Melchizedek'?
questions.answer: The coming Davidic king (fulfilled in Christ).

questions.question: Before Isaac was born, whom did Abram name as his heir?
questions.answer: Eliezer of Damascus.

questions.question: What did God tell Abram instead of accepting Eliezer as heir?
questions.answer: That Abram's own son would be his heir.

questions.question: What sign did Abraham's servant pray for at the well to identify the right wife for Isaac?
questions.answer: That the woman who offered to water his camels too would be the one God chose.

questions.question: What land did Lot choose for himself when he and Abraham separated?
questions.answer: The well-watered Jordan plain, near Sodom.

questions.question: Who rescued Lot after he was captured by invading kings?
questions.answer: Abraham.

questions.question: What does 2 Peter call Lot, despite his poor choices?
questions.answer: Righteous.

questions.question: What did Abraham tell Abimelech Sarah was, out of fear for his life?
questions.answer: That she was only his sister.

questions.question: How did God warn Abimelech not to touch Sarah?
questions.answer: Through a dream.

questions.question: Decades later, which patriarch faced an almost identical episode with a king named Abimelech?
questions.answer: Isaac, regarding his wife Rebekah.

questions.question: Which of Laban's daughters was substituted for Rachel on Jacob's wedding night?
questions.answer: Leah.

questions.question: How many years total did Jacob serve Laban for his two wives?
questions.answer: Fourteen years (seven for each).

questions.question: How many times did Laban change Jacob's wages over their twenty years together?
questions.answer: Ten times.

questions.question: Which of Jacob's sons did Leah bear that became the ancestor of David and Christ?
questions.answer: Judah.

questions.question: What did the LORD do when He saw that Leah was unloved?
questions.answer: He opened her womb.

questions.question: Where was Leah buried?
questions.answer: In the cave at Machpelah, beside Jacob.

questions.question: How many years did Jacob work to marry Rachel?
questions.answer: Fourteen years total (seven, then seven more).

questions.question: What did Rachel cry out to Jacob in her desperation for children?
questions.answer: 'Give me children, or else I die.'

questions.question: What name did Rachel give her second son with her dying breath, which Jacob later changed?
questions.answer: Ben-oni ('son of my sorrow'), which Jacob renamed Benjamin.

questions.question: Whose maidservant was Bilhah before she became Jacob's wife?
questions.answer: Rachel's.

questions.question: Which two of Jacob's sons did Bilhah bear?
questions.answer: Dan and Naphtali.

questions.question: Which of Jacob's sons was later condemned for lying with Bilhah?
questions.answer: Reuben.

questions.question: Whose maidservant was Zilpah before she became Jacob's wife?
questions.answer: Leah's.

questions.question: Which two of Jacob's sons did Zilpah bear?
questions.answer: Gad and Asher.

questions.question: What prompted Leah to give Zilpah to Jacob as a wife?
questions.answer: Leah's childbearing had paused after her first four sons.

questions.question: Whose daughter was Dinah?
questions.answer: Jacob and Leah's.

questions.question: Who assaulted Dinah while she visited the women of Shechem?
questions.answer: Shechem, son of Hamor.

questions.question: Which two of Dinah's brothers massacred the men of Shechem in revenge?
questions.answer: Simeon and Levi.

questions.question: How many of Judah's sons did Tamar marry before both died?
questions.answer: Two -- Er and Onan.

questions.question: What did Judah declare about Tamar once he realized the truth?
questions.answer: That she was more righteous than he was.

questions.question: What were the names of Tamar's twin sons?
questions.answer: Perez and Zerah.

questions.question: What position did Potiphar hold in Pharaoh's court?
questions.answer: Captain of the bodyguard.

questions.question: Why did Potiphar put Joseph in charge of his entire household?
questions.answer: Because he saw the LORD was with Joseph and caused all he did to succeed.

questions.question: What false accusation led Potiphar to imprison Joseph?
questions.answer: That Joseph had assaulted his wife.

questions.question: Whose daughter was Asenath?
questions.answer: Potiphera, priest of On.

questions.question: What were the names of Asenath and Joseph's two sons?
questions.answer: Manasseh and Ephraim.

questions.question: What does the name Ephraim mean, according to Joseph's own explanation?
questions.answer: 'God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.'

questions.question: What did Pharaoh command Shiphrah and Puah to do to Hebrew baby boys?
questions.answer: Kill them at birth.

questions.question: Why did Shiphrah and Puah refuse Pharaoh's command?
questions.answer: Because they feared God.

questions.question: How did God reward Shiphrah and Puah for their courage?
questions.answer: He established households for them.

questions.question: Who was Puah's fellow midwife in defying Pharaoh's order?
questions.answer: Shiphrah.

questions.question: What excuse did Puah and Shiphrah give Pharaoh for why the Hebrew boys survived?
questions.answer: That Hebrew women gave birth too quickly for the midwives to arrive in time.

questions.question: What does Exodus say God did because the midwives feared Him?
questions.answer: He was good to them and gave them households.

questions.question: What was Jethro's occupation in Midian?
questions.answer: He was a priest.

questions.question: Which of Jethro's daughters did Moses marry?
questions.answer: Zipporah.

questions.question: What advice did Jethro give Moses about judging the people?
questions.answer: To appoint capable leaders over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens to share the burden.

questions.question: Whose sons were Nadab and Abihu?
questions.answer: Aaron's.

questions.question: What did Nadab and Abihu offer that God had not commanded?
questions.answer: Strange fire.

questions.question: What happened to Nadab and Abihu as a result?
questions.answer: Fire came out from the LORD and consumed them.

questions.question: Which of Aaron's sons was Abihu's brother in the strange fire incident?
questions.answer: Nadab.

questions.question: What did Moses tell Aaron God meant by this judgment?
questions.answer: 'By those who come near Me I will be treated as holy.'

questions.question: Through which of his other sons did the priesthood continue after Abihu's death?
questions.answer: Eleazar and Ithamar.

questions.question: What was Korah's core complaint against Moses and Aaron?
questions.answer: That the whole congregation was equally holy, so Moses and Aaron had no special right to lead.

questions.question: What happened to the ground beneath Korah and his household?
questions.answer: It opened up and swallowed them alive.

questions.question: What happened to Korah's own descendants, despite his rebellion?
questions.answer: They did not die, and later became temple musicians and psalm-writers.

questions.question: Who hired Balaam to curse Israel?
questions.answer: Balak, king of Moab.

questions.question: What animal rebuked Balaam on the road?
questions.answer: His donkey.

questions.question: Instead of cursing Israel, what did Balaam end up doing three times?
questions.answer: Blessing them.

questions.question: What kingdom did Balak rule?
questions.answer: Moab.

questions.question: Why was Balak afraid of Israel?
questions.answer: Because they were so numerous.

questions.question: How did Balak respond when Balaam blessed Israel a third time instead of cursing them?
questions.answer: He grew furious and dismissed Balaam without payment.

questions.question: Why did Zelophehad's daughters petition Moses for an inheritance?
questions.answer: Because their father died with no sons, and they didn't want his name lost from his clan.

questions.question: What did God say about the daughters' request?
questions.answer: That they were right, and He established a permanent inheritance law for daughters.

questions.question: Name all five of Zelophehad's daughters.
questions.answer: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

questions.question: What later condition was placed on Zelophehad's daughters regarding marriage?
questions.answer: They had to marry within their own tribe so the land would not pass to another tribe.

questions.question: In which book is the inheritance of Zelophehad's daughters confirmed in the actual land allotment?
questions.answer: Joshua.

questions.question: Whose tribe did Zelophehad and his daughters belong to?
questions.answer: Manasseh.

questions.question: Before whom did Zelophehad's daughters bring their case?
questions.answer: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation.

questions.question: Whose daughter was Achsah?
questions.answer: Caleb's.

questions.question: What did Caleb promise to whoever captured Kiriath-sepher?
questions.answer: His daughter Achsah in marriage.

questions.question: What did Achsah boldly ask her father for, in addition to land?
questions.answer: Springs of water.

questions.question: What two roles did Deborah hold in Israel?
questions.answer: Prophetess and judge.

questions.question: Whom did Deborah summon to lead Israel's army against Sisera?
questions.answer: Barak.

questions.question: Who actually killed Sisera, fulfilling Deborah's prophecy that a woman would get the credit?
questions.answer: Jael.

questions.question: Under what condition did Barak agree to lead Israel's army?
questions.answer: Only if Deborah went with him.

questions.question: How many men did Barak gather at Mount Tabor?
questions.answer: Ten thousand.

questions.question: In which New Testament passage is Barak listed among the heroes of faith?
questions.answer: Hebrews 11.

questions.question: What sign did Gideon test God with twice, using wool?
questions.answer: The fleece test.

questions.question: How many men did God leave Gideon with to fight the Midianites?
What did Gideon make after his victory that became a snare to Israel?
questions.answer: A golden ephod.

questions.question: What parable did Jotham tell the men of Shechem?
questions.answer: The parable of the trees choosing a king.

questions.question: Why was Jotham the only one of Gideon's seventy sons to survive?
questions.answer: He hid while Abimelech had the others killed.

questions.question: What did Jotham warn would happen if Shechem's support for Abimelech was not in good faith?
questions.answer: Fire would come out and consume both Abimelech and Shechem.

questions.question: To whom did the angel of the LORD first appear to announce Samson's birth?
questions.answer: Manoah's wife.

questions.question: What did Manoah fear after the angel ascended in the sacrifice's flame?
questions.answer: That he and his wife would die because they had seen God.

questions.question: Where was Samson buried, in Manoah's family tomb?
questions.answer: Between Zorah and Eshtaol.

questions.question: How much silver did the Philistine lords offer Delilah to discover Samson's secret?
questions.answer: Eleven hundred pieces each.

questions.question: What was the true secret of Samson's strength?
questions.answer: His uncut hair, a sign of his Nazirite vow.

questions.question: What happened to Samson immediately after his hair was cut?
questions.answer: The LORD departed from him and his strength left him.

questions.question: What did Micah confess to stealing from his own mother?
questions.answer: Eleven hundred pieces of silver.

questions.question: What summary verse describes the moral chaos of this period in Judges?
questions.answer: 'Everyone did what was right in his own eyes.'

questions.question: Which tribe took Micah's idols and priest by force?
questions.answer: Dan.

questions.question: How many wives did Elkanah have?
questions.answer: Two -- Hannah and Peninnah.

questions.question: What did Elkanah ask Hannah to comfort her grief over being childless?
questions.answer: 'Am I not more to you than ten sons?'

questions.question: Where did Elkanah's family travel every year to worship and sacrifice?
questions.answer: Shiloh.

questions.question: Why did Eli initially think Hannah was drunk?
questions.answer: She was praying silently, only moving her lips.

questions.question: What did Hannah vow if God gave her a son?
questions.answer: She would dedicate him to the LORD's service for all his life.

questions.question: What later New Testament song echoes Hannah's prayer of praise?
questions.answer: Mary's Magnificat.

questions.question: What advantage did Peninnah have over Hannah?
questions.answer: She had children, while Hannah had none.

questions.question: How did Peninnah use this advantage?
questions.answer: She provoked and irritated Hannah bitterly over her childlessness.

questions.question: When did Peninnah's provocation of Hannah happen most intensely?
questions.answer: Year by year, during the family's trips to worship at Shiloh.

questions.question: Whose sons were Joel and Abijah?
questions.answer: Samuel's.

questions.question: What corrupt behavior did Joel and Abijah practice as judges?
questions.answer: They took bribes and perverted justice.

questions.question: What did Israel's elders demand because of Joel and Abijah's corruption?
questions.answer: A king to rule over them.

questions.question: Where was Abijah stationed as a judge alongside his brother Joel?
questions.answer: Beersheba.

questions.question: What contrast does 1 Samuel draw between Samuel and his sons?
questions.answer: His sons did not walk in his ways.

questions.question: According to God's own words to Samuel, whom were the people really rejecting by demanding a king?
questions.answer: God Himself.

questions.question: What had Saul promised to whoever defeated Goliath?
questions.answer: His daughter in marriage.

questions.question: Whom did Saul give Merab to instead of David?
questions.answer: Adriel of Meholah.

questions.question: What happened to Merab's five sons during David's reign?
questions.answer: They were handed over to the Gibeonites and executed to atone for Saul's violence against them.

questions.question: Whose concubine was Rizpah?
questions.answer: Saul's.

questions.question: What did Rizpah do to protect her sons' exposed bodies?
questions.answer: She kept vigil on a rock, guarding them from birds and animals for months.

questions.question: What did David do once he heard of Rizpah's vigil?
questions.answer: He gave Saul's whole family, including Saul and Jonathan's bones, a proper burial.

questions.question: What did Barzillai bring David and his men while they fled Absalom?
questions.answer: Beds, basins, pottery, and food.

questions.question: Why did Barzillai decline David's offer to live in the palace?
questions.answer: He said he was eighty years old and would only be a burden.

questions.question: Whom did Barzillai ask David to favor in his place?
questions.answer: His son Chimham.

questions.question: What nationality was Ittai the Gittite?
questions.answer: Philistine (from Gath).

questions.question: What did Ittai declare to David when given the chance to turn back?
questions.answer: Wherever David went, whether to death or life, Ittai would be there too.

questions.question: What command did David give Ittai in the battle against Absalom?
questions.answer: Command of a third of David's army.

questions.question: What did Araunah own that David needed to build an altar?
questions.answer: A threshing floor.

questions.question: What did Araunah offer David for free?
questions.answer: The threshing floor, oxen, and equipment for the sacrifice.

questions.question: Why did David insist on paying full price instead of accepting it as a gift?
questions.answer: He would not offer to God something that cost him nothing.

questions.question: What did Hiram supply for the construction of Solomon's temple?
questions.answer: Cedar and cypress timber and skilled craftsmen.

questions.question: What did Solomon give Hiram in exchange for his materials and labor?
questions.answer: Wheat and oil, and later twenty cities in Galilee.

questions.question: What did Hiram name the region of cities Solomon gave him, being displeased with them?
questions.answer: Cabul.

questions.question: Why did the Queen of Sheba travel to see Solomon?
questions.answer: To test his wisdom with hard questions.

questions.question: What did the Queen of Sheba say after seeing Solomon's wisdom and kingdom?
questions.answer: That the reality exceeded everything she had heard.

questions.question: Who later cited the Queen of Sheba's journey approvingly as an example of seeking wisdom?
questions.answer: Jesus.

questions.question: What did Ahijah do to his cloak to symbolize the kingdom being torn from Solomon's son?
questions.answer: He tore it into twelve pieces.

questions.question: How many pieces of the torn cloak did Ahijah give Jeroboam?
questions.answer: Ten.

questions.question: How did Jeroboam's wife try to keep Ahijah from recognizing her?
questions.answer: She disguised herself.

questions.question: How many court prophets predicted victory before Micaiah was consulted?
Why did Ahab admit he hated Micaiah?
questions.answer: Because Micaiah never prophesied good concerning him, only evil.

questions.question: What happened to Ahab exactly as Micaiah had prophesied?
questions.answer: He was struck by a stray arrow and died in battle.

questions.question: Whom did Shallum assassinate to seize Israel's throne?
questions.answer: Zechariah.

questions.question: How long did Shallum reign before he too was assassinated?
questions.answer: One month.

questions.question: Whose dynasty ended when Shallum killed Zechariah?
questions.answer: Jehu's.

questions.question: Whom did Menahem kill to seize Israel's throne?
questions.answer: Shallum.

questions.question: What did Menahem do to the city of Tiphsah when it refused to submit?
questions.answer: He attacked it brutally.

questions.question: To which Assyrian king did Menahem pay a massive tribute to secure his throne?
questions.answer: Pul (Tiglath-pileser III).

questions.question: Who was Pekahiah's father and predecessor as king?
questions.answer: Menahem.

questions.question: How long did Pekahiah reign?
questions.answer: Two years.

questions.question: Who assassinated Pekahiah?
questions.answer: Pekah, his own military officer.

questions.question: Which foreign king did Pekah ally with to attack Judah?
questions.answer: Rezin, king of Aram.

questions.question: Which prophet confronted King Ahaz during Pekah's war against Judah?
questions.answer: Isaiah.

questions.question: Who assassinated Pekah and became Israel's final king?
questions.answer: Hoshea.

questions.question: How old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and how long did he reign?
questions.answer: 16 years old, for 52 years.

questions.question: What unauthorized act did Uzziah commit in the temple?
questions.answer: He tried to burn incense on the altar, a priestly duty.

questions.question: What happened to Uzziah when the priests confronted him?
questions.answer: Leprosy broke out on his forehead.

questions.question: Whose son was Eliakim, Hezekiah's palace administrator?
questions.answer: Hilkiah's.

questions.question: What image did Isaiah use to describe Eliakim's secure position?
questions.answer: 'A peg in a firm place.'

questions.question: Whom did Eliakim replace in this position of authority?
questions.answer: Shebna.

questions.question: What had Shebna carved for himself that drew Isaiah's rebuke?
questions.answer: An elaborate tomb.

questions.question: What position did Shebna hold before his demotion?
questions.answer: Steward over the household (palace administrator).

questions.question: What lesser title did Shebna hold by the time of Sennacherib's siege?
questions.answer: Secretary.

questions.question: What position did Joah hold in Hezekiah's court?
questions.answer: Recorder.

questions.question: What did Joah and his fellow officials do after hearing Rabshakeh's threats?
questions.answer: They tore their clothes in distress.

questions.question: Who were Joah's two fellow officials sent to meet Rabshakeh?
questions.answer: Eliakim and Shebna.

questions.question: What did Sennacherib's field commander Rabshakeh compare the LORD to, mockingly?
questions.answer: The powerless gods of other nations Assyria had already conquered.

questions.question: What did Hezekiah do with Sennacherib's threatening letter?
questions.answer: He spread it before the LORD in the temple and prayed.

questions.question: How many men in Sennacherib's camp did the angel of the LORD strike down in one night?
How did Sennacherib eventually die?
questions.answer: He was assassinated by two of his own sons while worshiping his god.

questions.question: What did Hilkiah give to Shaphan that had been found during temple repairs?
questions.answer: The Book of the Law.

questions.question: How did King Josiah react when Shaphan read the book aloud to him?
questions.answer: He tore his clothes.

questions.question: Which prophetess did Josiah's delegation, including Shaphan, consult about the book?
questions.answer: Huldah.

questions.question: What was Jehoiakim's name before Pharaoh Necho changed it?
questions.answer: Eliakim.

questions.question: What did Jehoiakim do to Jeremiah's scroll as it was read to him?
questions.answer: He cut it with a knife and burned it in the fire, section by section.

questions.question: What did Jeremiah confront Jehoiakim for doing to build his palace?
questions.answer: Using forced, unpaid labor.

questions.question: What did Zacharias ask Gabriel that led to his being struck mute?
questions.answer: 'How will I know this for certain?' -- a request for proof.

questions.question: What name did Zacharias confirm in writing for his newborn son?
questions.answer: John.

questions.question: What is Zacharias's prophetic song, spoken once his voice returned, commonly called?
questions.answer: The Benedictus.

questions.question: What relation was Elizabeth to Mary?
questions.answer: A relative (kinswoman).

questions.question: What happened the moment Mary greeted Elizabeth?
questions.answer: The baby (John) leaped in Elizabeth's womb.

questions.question: What title did Elizabeth give Mary when she recognized her, filled with the Holy Spirit?
questions.answer: 'The mother of my Lord.'

questions.question: What had the Holy Spirit revealed to Simeon before his death?
questions.answer: That he would not die before seeing the Lord's Christ.

questions.question: What is Simeon's prayer of praise, spoken after holding the infant Jesus, commonly called?
questions.answer: The Nunc Dimittis.

questions.question: What did Simeon prophesy would pierce Mary's own soul?
questions.answer: A sword.

questions.question: What tribe did the prophetess Anna belong to?
questions.answer: Asher.

questions.question: How did Anna spend her time at the temple?
questions.answer: Worshiping with fasting and prayer night and day.

questions.question: To whom did Anna speak about the infant Jesus after recognizing Him?
questions.answer: All those looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.

questions.question: Why had Herod Antipas imprisoned John the Baptist?
questions.answer: Because John condemned his marriage to Herodias, his brother's wife.

questions.question: What happened when Jesus was sent to Herod during His trial and questioned by him?
questions.answer: Jesus answered him nothing.

questions.question: What changed between Herod and Pilate after this encounter?
questions.answer: They became friends, having formerly been enemies.

questions.question: Whom was Herodias married to before marrying Herod Antipas?
questions.answer: Herod Philip (his brother).

questions.question: What did Herodias instruct her daughter to ask Herod for?
questions.answer: The head of John the Baptist.

questions.question: Why couldn't Herodias have John killed earlier, despite wanting to?
questions.answer: Herod protected John, respecting him as a righteous and holy man.

questions.question: What did Herod promise his stepdaughter after her dance pleased him?
questions.answer: Whatever she asked, up to half his kingdom.

questions.question: Where does the traditional name 'Salome' for Herodias's daughter come from?
questions.answer: The historian Josephus, not the Gospels themselves.

questions.question: How was John the Baptist's head delivered, per her request?
questions.answer: On a platter.

questions.question: What was Jairus's role in the community?
questions.answer: A synagogue official.

questions.question: What news reached Jairus while Jesus was delayed on the way to his house?
questions.answer: That his daughter had already died.

questions.question: What did Jesus say to Jairus's daughter to raise her?
questions.answer: 'Talitha kum' ('Little girl, get up').

questions.question: Whom was Matthias chosen to replace among the twelve apostles?
questions.answer: Judas Iscariot.

questions.question: What qualification did Peter require of a replacement apostle?
questions.answer: He must have accompanied the apostles the whole time Jesus was among them, from John's baptism to the ascension.

questions.question: How did the apostles decide between Matthias and Joseph called Barsabbas?
questions.answer: They prayed and cast lots.

questions.question: By what other name was Joseph called Barsabbas also known?
questions.answer: Justus.

questions.question: Who was chosen instead of Joseph called Barsabbas?
questions.answer: Matthias.

questions.question: What method did the believers use to choose between the two candidates?
questions.answer: Casting lots, after prayer.

questions.question: What was Rhoda's role in the household where believers were praying for Peter?
questions.answer: A servant girl.

questions.question: What did Rhoda do instead of opening the gate when she recognized Peter's voice?
questions.answer: She ran back inside to announce it, leaving Peter outside.

questions.question: How did the praying believers react to Rhoda's report at first?
questions.answer: They didn't believe her, saying she was out of her mind.

questions.question: Whose mother was Mary, in whose house believers gathered to pray?
questions.answer: John Mark's.

questions.question: What were the believers in Mary's house praying for?
questions.answer: Peter's release from prison.

questions.question: Where did Peter go directly after being freed from prison by an angel?
questions.answer: Mary's house.

questions.question: What does Paul say Alexander the coppersmith did to him?
questions.answer: Did him much harm.

questions.question: Who does Paul say will repay Alexander, rather than Paul taking revenge himself?
questions.answer: The Lord.

questions.question: What did Paul warn Timothy to do regarding Alexander?
questions.answer: Be on guard against him.

questions.question: What false teaching did Hymenaeus and Philetus spread about the resurrection?
questions.answer: That the resurrection had already taken place.

questions.question: What did Paul do to Hymenaeus (and Alexander) as discipline?
questions.answer: Handed them over to Satan, to be taught not to blaspheme.

questions.question: What does Paul compare this kind of false teaching to, in warning Timothy?
questions.answer: Gangrene.

questions.question: Who is Philetus paired with in spreading a false teaching about the resurrection?
questions.answer: Hymenaeus.

questions.question: What effect did Philetus and Hymenaeus's teaching have on some believers?
questions.answer: It upset their faith.

questions.question: What kind of talk does Paul say leads to this kind of ungodliness?
questions.answer: Worldly and empty chatter.

questions.question: What position did Crispus hold in Corinth?
questions.answer: Ruler of the synagogue.

questions.question: Who believed in the Lord along with Crispus?
questions.answer: His whole household.

questions.question: Along with Gaius, who baptized Crispus personally?
questions.answer: Paul.

questions.question: What happened to Sosthenes in front of Gallio's judgment seat?
questions.answer: He was seized and beaten by the crowd.

questions.question: What position did Sosthenes hold before this incident?
questions.answer: Ruler of the synagogue in Corinth.

questions.question: How does Paul refer to Sosthenes at the opening of 1 Corinthians, suggesting he later became a believer?
questions.answer: 'Sosthenes our brother.'

questions.question: What does Paul call Gaius in Romans, describing his hospitality?
questions.answer: 'My host and host of the whole church.'

questions.question: Along with Crispus, whom else did Paul personally baptize in Corinth?
questions.answer: Gaius.

questions.question: What happened to a Gaius during the riot in Ephesus?
questions.answer: He was seized by the crowd and dragged into the theater.

questions.question: What was Tertius's role in producing Paul's letter to the Romans?
questions.answer: He was the scribe who physically wrote it as Paul dictated.

questions.question: What does Tertius add to the letter in his own voice?
questions.answer: A personal greeting to the Roman believers.

questions.question: In which of his letters does Paul note writing a portion 'with my own hand' as a departure from his usual dictation practice?
questions.answer: Galatians.

questions.question: What church was Phoebe a servant (or deacon) of?
questions.answer: The church at Cenchrea.

questions.question: What does Paul say Phoebe had been to many people, including himself?
questions.answer: A helper.

questions.question: What is Phoebe traditionally believed to have done with Paul's letter to the Romans?
questions.answer: Carried it from Corinth to Rome and delivered it.

questions.question: What relationship does Paul claim with Junia and Andronicus?
questions.answer: They were his kinsmen and fellow prisoners.

questions.question: What striking phrase does Paul use to describe Junia and Andronicus's standing?
questions.answer: 'Outstanding among the apostles.'

questions.question: What does Paul say about the timing of Junia's conversion compared to his own?
questions.answer: She was in Christ before he was.

questions.question: Who is Andronicus paired with in Paul's greeting in Romans 16:7?
questions.answer: Junia.

questions.question: What did Andronicus share with Paul at some point in his ministry?
questions.answer: Imprisonment (he was Paul's fellow prisoner).

questions.question: What phrase does Paul use to describe Andronicus's early Christian standing?
questions.answer: 'In Christ before me.'

questions.question: What does Paul say Onesiphorus was not, unlike others, regarding Paul's imprisonment?
questions.answer: Ashamed of his chains.

questions.question: What did Onesiphorus do once he arrived in Rome?
questions.answer: He eagerly searched for Paul until he found him.

questions.question: Whom does Paul greet instead of Onesiphorus himself in his closing words, suggesting Onesiphorus may have died?
questions.answer: The household of Onesiphorus.

questions.question: What false assumption about Trophimus sparked a riot against Paul in Jerusalem?
questions.answer: That Paul had brought Trophimus, a Gentile, into the restricted area of the temple.

questions.question: Where was Trophimus from?
questions.answer: Ephesus.

questions.question: Where did Paul leave Trophimus sick, according to his final letter to Timothy?
questions.answer: Miletus.

questions.question: What two purposes did Paul send Tychicus to the Ephesians for?
questions.answer: To tell them of Paul's circumstances and to comfort their hearts.

questions.question: What title does Paul give Tychicus in both Ephesians and Colossians?
questions.answer: 'Beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord.'

questions.question: To which island did Paul consider sending Tychicus to relieve Titus?
questions.answer: Crete.

questions.question: What was Publius's role on the island of Malta?
questions.answer: He was the leading official (chief man) of the island.

questions.question: What did Paul do for Publius's father, who was sick with fever and dysentery?
questions.answer: Prayed, laid hands on him, and healed him.

questions.question: What happened after word spread of this healing?
questions.answer: The rest of the sick people on the island came to Paul and were healed too.

questions.question: What threefold testimony does John give for Demetrius's character?
questions.answer: From everyone, from the truth itself, and from John and his companions.

questions.question: Which self-serving church leader is Demetrius held up in contrast to in 3 John?
questions.answer: Diotrephes.

questions.question: In which New Testament letter is Demetrius commended?
questions.answer: 3 John.

questions.question: What did Agabus prophesy would spread over the whole world during the reign of Claudius?
questions.answer: A great famine.

questions.question: How did the believers at Antioch respond to Agabus's famine prophecy?
questions.answer: They sent relief to the believers in Judea.

questions.question: What object did Agabus use to act out his prophecy about Paul's arrest?
questions.answer: Paul's own belt.

questions.question: To whom is the entire letter of 3 John addressed?
questions.answer: Gaius.

questions.question: What was Gaius commended for in 3 John?
questions.answer: His faithful hospitality toward traveling missionaries and strangers.

questions.question: What term of affection does John repeat for Gaius throughout the letter?
questions.answer: 'Beloved.'
